title: Inverse-limit acyclicity of levelwise pushforward of a K-injective tower
statement: Let C and D be small sites, R and S sheaves of rings whose section rings are commutative, and f a ringed-topos morphism from (C,R) to (D,S) [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Choose the ordinary unbounded derived categories of the two tower module categories and of S-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let I be a K-injective unbounded complex of strict inverse sequences of R-module sheaves and T a K-injective unbounded complex of strict inverse sequences of S-module sheaves [def-pur-kinjective-complex, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every quasi-isomorphism j from the levelwise module direct image f_*I to T, the chain map obtained by applying ordinary inverse limit degreewise to j is a quasi-isomorphism. No exactness of countable products or of module pullback is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A07, lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim, first proof; Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition, K-flat pullback argument specialized to the constant-tower adjunction

proof.text: Regard each sectionwise commutative RingCat sheaf as an explicitly constructed CommRingCat sheaf with exactly the same underlying ring sheaf. On modules, use K-flat replacements with flat terms. On strict towers apply the stated diagram replacement theorem on a universe-lifted copy of the index category, restrict back, and transpose the resulting strict functor to a complex of towers. Evaluation detects its augmentation quasi-isomorphism. The module resolution is the existing flatKFlat_resolutions helper in RingedToposDerivedPushforwardComposition; its predicate is an equivalent two-field structure.

Choose the module pullback left adjoint to the supplied direct image. Apply its adjunction levelwise. It sends quasi-isomorphisms between the good tower complexes of step 1 to quasi-isomorphisms, since evaluation detects quasi-isomorphisms and the stated K-flat pullback theorem applies at each level. The constant tower functor is exact, is left adjoint to inverse limit, and carries a good module complex to a good tower complex.

Work in homotopy categories localized at quasi-isomorphisms. For a good complex P and a K-injective I, the pullback/direct-image adjunction identifies Hom(P,f_*I) with Hom(f^*P,I). Show that Hom(P,f_*I) maps bijectively to the corresponding localized Hom: represent localized maps by right fractions, replace their denominator source by a good resolution, use pullback inversion of good quasi-isomorphisms, then use the K-injective bijection of homotopy maps with derived maps. This proves both injectivity and surjectivity, without asserting that f_*I is K-injective. This is the original hom_localization_bijective helper used privately by the now-exported isIso_map_of_adjoints theorem, imported from RingedToposDerivedPushforwardComposition rather than copied.

Apply the preceding bijection to the levelwise adjunction, the constant/limit adjunction, and their composite. For every good module complex P, adjunction identifies postcomposition with lim(j) in the localized Hom from P with postcomposition with j in the localized Hom from the constant tower on P. The latter is bijective because j is a quasi-isomorphism and T is K-injective. Every localized object has a good representative by step 1, so postcomposition with lim(j) is bijective from every object. Yoneda implies that lim(j) is invertible after localization, which is precisely the asserted quasi-isomorphism. Apply the original exported isIso_map_of_adjoints helper to these two adjunctions and their resolving classes.

proof_origin.place: Explicit localization-by-right-fractions argument realizing the K-flat adjunction proof of Tag 0D6E for the tower square of Tag 0A07. lean.statement:
theorem ringedTowerPushforwardLimitAcyclic
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}) (S : Sheaf K RingCat.{u})
    (hcommR : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a b : R.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
    (hcommS : ∀ (U : Dᵒᵖ) (a b : S.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} S)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} S)]
    (f : RingedToposMorphism R S)
    (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} R) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (T : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} S) ℤ) (hT : T.IsKInjective)
    (j : ((((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ (ringedSiteModules.{u} R)
        (ringedSiteModules.{u} S)).obj f.modules).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I) ⟶ T) [QuasiIso j] :
    QuasiIso (((lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} S) ⥤ _).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map j)
